description: Claude Forge — TypeScript Edition. Automated safety net for development sessions.

PreToolUse.description: Block --no-verify and bypass flags in git commands

hooks.command: node -e "const i=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'));const c=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/--no-verify|--no-gpg-sign/.test(c)&&/git\s+(commit|push|merge|rebase)/.test(c)){console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'block',reason:'Hook bypass flags are not allowed. Fix the underlying issue instead.'}));}process.exit(0)"

PreToolUse.description: Block commits containing secrets, console.log, or debugger in staged changes

hooks.command:
node -e "const i=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'));const c=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(!/git\s+commit/.test(c)){process.exit(0);}const{execSync}=require('child_process');try{const d=execSync('git diff --cached --diff-filter=ACM',{encoding:'utf8'});const issues=[];const warns=[];const secretPat=/ (?:api[_-]?key|secret[_-]?key|password|token|credentials|private[_-]?key|client[_-]?secret) \s*[:=]\s*["'`][^"'`\s]{8,}/i;const secretPat2=/ (?:sk_live|sk_test|ghp_|gho_|github_pat_|xoxb-|xoxp-|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16})\w+/;if(secretPat.test(d)||secretPat2.test(d))issues.push('Possible hardcoded secret');let logs=0;d.split('
').forEach(l=>{if(l.startsWith('+')&&!l.startsWith('+++')){if(/console\.log\(/.test(l))logs++;if(/ debugger /.test(l))issues.push('debugger statement found');}});if(logs>0)warns.push(logs+' console.log(s) — use structured logger');if(issues.length)console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'block',reason:'Pre-commit scan failed:
- '+issues.join('
- ')}));else if(warns.length)console.log(JSON.stringify({message:'Pre-commit warnings:
- '+warns.join('
- ')}));}catch(e){}process.exit(0)"

node -e "const i=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'));const c=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/git\s+push.*--force(?!-)/.test(c)){console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'block',reason:'Force push blocked. Use --force-with-lease for safety.'}));}process.exit(0)"

PreToolUse.description: Warn before modifying linter, formatter, or CI config files

hooks.command: node -e "const i=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'));const f=i.tool_input?.file_path||'';const p=['.eslintrc','eslint.config','.prettierrc','tsconfig.json','biome.json','.github/workflows','jest.config','vitest.config','next.config','tailwind.config','prisma/schema.prisma'];const h=p.find(x=>f.includes(x));if(h)console.log(JSON.stringify({message:'Modifying config: '+h+'. Ensure this is intentional.'}));process.exit(0)"

PreToolUse.description: Block NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix on server-only secrets in env files and source code

hooks.command: node -e "const i=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'));const c=i.tool_input?.new_string||i.tool_input?.content||'';const f=i.tool_input?.file_path||'';const pat=/NEXT_PUBLIC_[A-Z_]*(SECRET|PASSWORD|PRIVATE|KEY|TOKEN|CREDENTIAL|API_KEY|CLIENT_SECRET)[A-Z_]*/i;const matches=[...c.matchAll(new RegExp(pat,'gi'))];if(matches.length){const names=matches.map(m=>m[0]).join(', ');console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'block',reason:'NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix exposes secrets to the browser: '+names+'. Remove the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix — these must be server-only env vars.'}));}process.exit(0)"

PostToolUse.description: Warn if console.log was added (skips test files)

hooks.command: node -e "const i=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'));const c=i.tool_input?.new_string||i.tool_input?.content||'';const f=i.tool_input?.file_path||'';if(/\.(test|spec|stories)\.[jt]sx?$/.test(f))process.exit(0);if(/console\.log\(/.test(c))console.log(JSON.stringify({message:'console.log detected in '+f.split('/').pop()+'. Use structured logger instead.'}));process.exit(0)"

node -e "const i=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'));const c=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/npm run build|npx tsc|next build|npm run typecheck/.test(c)&&(i.tool_output?.exit_code||0)!==0)console.log(JSON.stringify({message:'Build failed. Run /fix to resolve errors incrementally.'}));process.exit(0)"

PostToolUse.description: Warn when an edited file exceeds 800 lines

hooks.command: node -e "const i=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'));const f=i.tool_input?.file_path;if(!f)process.exit(0);try{const lines=require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8').split('\n').length;if(lines>800)console.log(JSON.stringify({message:f.split('/').pop()+' is '+lines+' lines (limit: 800). Consider splitting by responsibility.'}));}catch(e){}process.exit(0)"

PostToolUse.description: Warn if .env file created/modified without .gitignore entry

hooks.command: node -e "const i=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8'));const f=i.tool_input?.file_path||'';if(!/\.env/.test(f)||/\.env\.example$|\.env\.template$/.test(f))process.exit(0);try{const gi=require('fs').readFileSync('.gitignore','utf8');if(!gi.includes('.env'))console.log(JSON.stringify({message:'WARNING: .env file modified but .env is not in .gitignore. Add it to prevent committing secrets.'}));}catch(e){console.log(JSON.stringify({message:'WARNING: .env file created but no .gitignore found. Create one with .env entry.'}));}process.exit(0)"

Stop.description: Remind to add tests if source files changed but no test files were touched

hooks.command: node -e "try{const{execSync}=require('child_process');const files=execSync('git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACM HEAD 2>/dev/null',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim().split('\n').filter(Boolean);const src=files.filter(f=>/\.[jt]sx?$/.test(f)&&!/\.(test|spec|stories)\./.test(f)&&!/config/.test(f));const tests=files.filter(f=>/\.(test|spec)\.[jt]sx?$/.test(f));if(src.length>0&&tests.length===0)console.log(JSON.stringify({message:'Source files changed but no test files modified. Did you add tests? Run /tdd to add coverage.'}));}catch(e){}process.exit(0)"
